title: game/data/events.json: a run's events (PokeRogue's mystery encounters), their loot tables and the trainer classes they and the routes use (roguelite track RL-12b; logic/encounters.js)

loot.description: loot tables: an item id (items.json) and its weight; the `loot` command draws from one

classes.description: trainer classes: the route trainers who walk up on sight, and the `foe` command's trainers

name.description: what the player reads: Unpaid Intern

team.description: how many Billies, fewest and most

sight.description: what they say when they spot you

lose.description: what they say when they lose

likes.description: RT-2: the spot kinds a route trainer of the class stands on first (logic/route-trainers.js ROUTE_SPOTS)

intro.description: what you see first: lines of a script (docs/SCRIPTS.md), no commands

weight.description: how often it is drawn against the others (0: never)

repeat.description: true: may come again in the same run (else once a run)

biomes.description: only in these biomes (biomes.json); every biome when left out

need.description: a condition (docs/SCRIPTS.md): the option is shown greyed out until it holds

needText.description: what the greyed-out option says it needs (else made from the condition)

cost.description: Moneys paid when it is picked; greyed out without them

then.description: what happens: a script (docs/SCRIPTS.md), with the event commands
